question: Russia Parliamentary Election: Turnout
resolution_criteria:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Russia in September 2026.

This market will resolve according to the official voter turnout rate for the 2026 Russia Parliamentary election, defined as the total number of votes cast divided by the total number of eligible voters.

If the reported value falls exactly between two brackets, this market will resolve to the higher bracket.

If the results of this election are not known by October 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to the lowest bracket.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official election results reported by Russian government sources such as the Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used if official results are not available.
research:
I couldn't confirm any results-related information from on or before 2026-09-07. Some search results were published after the cutoff, so I left them out and do not describe them.

## 1. Resolution source
- The source that decides the outcome is the official turnout figure from Russia's Central Election Commission (CEC), cik.rf / izbirkom.ru. Note that the CEC's "turnout" counts ballots issued as a share of registered voters. On this date (2026-09-07) voting has not started, so there is no value yet.
- 2026-06-16: Putin signed the decree setting the State Duma election for 20 September 2026, with voting spread over several days (18-20 September). [iStories](https://istories.media/news/2026/06/16/putin-naznachil-vibori-v-gosdumu-na-20-sentyabrya/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Voting begins 2026-09-18, after this question closes.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- Early September 2026 (fieldwork 31 Aug to 6 Sep): a VTsIOM poll found about 70% of respondents saying they would vote. An earlier VTsIOM reading was about 66%. Stated intentions in Russia usually run well above official turnout; in 2021 they were in the 60s and official turnout was 51.7%. [TASS](https://tass.com/society/2185697), [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/07/02/russia-is-gearing-up-for-nationwide-elections-this-is-what-you-need-to-know-a93142/pdf)
- 2026-07-23: Meduza reported that the Kremlin lowered its target for United Russia's vote share twice: from 55% (or 60% internally in March) to 50% in June, then 45% in mid-July. The turnout target stayed at about 50% the whole time. Internally in March, regions were given 55% turnout as the target. Higher-performing regions are expected to deliver 50-55% turnout. [Meduza](https://meduza.io/feature/2026/07/23/kreml-uzhe-vo-vtoroy-raz-snizil-svoi-ozhidaniya-ot-edinoy-rossii-na-vyborah-v-gosdumu-s-55-golosov-do-45), [Moscow Times RU](https://ru.themoscowtimes.com/2026/07/23/kreml-snizil-tselevoi-rezultat-edinoi-rossii-naviborah-vgosdumu-do45-golosov-a201553)
- 2026-07 (headline only, I couldn't read the page): Intellinews reported "Kremlin lowers Duma election turnout, vote targets". [Intellinews](https://www.intellinews.com/kremlin-lowers-duma-election-turnout-vote-targets-456332/)
- 2026-06-26: Novaya Gazeta Europe reported:
  - Remote electronic voting (DEG) is planned in 33 of 89 regions.
  - Analyst Gallyamov estimates real turnout at about 20%, against an official target of about 55%.
  - Analyst Ternovoy says the authorities may deliberately keep the campaign low-key to dampen turnout.
  
  [Novaya Gazeta Europe](https://novayagazeta.eu/articles/2026/06/26/kak-vlasti-planiruiut-provodit-vybory-v-gosdumu-kogda-vsio-sypetsia)
- 2025-10-28: the Kremlin's earlier plan was at least 55% for United Russia. [Moscow Times RU](https://ru.themoscowtimes.com/2025/10/28/kreml-zadumal-narisovat-edinoi-rossii-ne-menee-55-golosov-na-predstoyaschih-viborah-v-gosdumu-a178469)
- 2024-12-02: at a seminar for vice-governors, the presidential administration first set targets of 55% for United Russia at 55% turnout. [Vedomosti](https://www.vedomosti.ru/politics/articles/2024/12/02/1078420-kreml-nazval-zhelaemii-rezultat-edinoi-rossii-na-viborah)

## 4. Base rates (official CEC Duma turnout, from my own knowledge, not re-checked in this session)
- 1993: about 54.8%. 1995: 64.4%. 1999: 61.9%. 2003: 55.7%. 2007: 63.7%. 2011: 60.2%. 2016: 47.9%. 2021: 51.7% (the first Duma vote over three days with DEG).
- Change between consecutive Duma elections is typically 4 to 12 points. From 2016 to 2021 it rose 3.8 points.
- Related votes: the 2024 presidential election had 77.5% turnout over three days with heavy DEG use, and the 2020 constitutional vote had 68%. Both show the system can produce high turnout when the Kremlin wants it. For Duma elections, though, the stated targets have been around 50-55%.
- The official 2021 figure is in the 50-53% bracket, and the Kremlin's stated 50-55% targets straddle the 50-53% and 53-56% brackets. More DEG regions and multi-day voting tend to push official turnout up.

## 5. Other forecasts
- On a Polymarket mirror (undated snapshot, about $26K volume), 53-56% led at about 30% and <47% was about 20%. [polymarkets.co.il mirror](https://polymarkets.co.il/nl/market/russia-parliamentary-election-turnout/)
- 2026-07-04 snapshot: 59-62% at about 15%, with thin liquidity (about $959). [Orrery](https://www.orrery.me/creator/will-voter-turnout-be-62-or-higher-in-the-2026-russian-parliamentary-election)
- Other bracket pages: [<47%](https://www.orrery.me/markets/will-voter-turnout-be-less-than-47-in-the-2026-russian-parliamentary-election), [53-56%](https://orrery.me/markets/will-voter-turnout-be-between-53-and-56-in-the-2026-russian-parliamentary-election), [56-59%](https://orrery.me/markets/will-voter-turnout-be-between-56-and-59-in-the-2026-russian-parliamentary-election)
- I couldn't find a live Polymarket price from 2026-09-07, any Kalshi or Manifold market, or a formal expert point forecast beyond the targets above.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-18 to 09-20: voting days. The CEC usually publishes intraday turnout (for example around 25% partway through) and DEG participation.
- 2026-09-21 onward: preliminary turnout, then final turnout once all protocols are processed. Small revisions between the preliminary and final figures (a few tenths of a point) could matter near a bracket edge, since a value exactly on a boundary resolves to the higher bracket.
- Watch for:
  - any late reports of revised turnout targets from the Kremlin
  - how many people register for DEG
  - turnout in high-turnout "electoral sultanate" regions such as Chechnya and Tuva, and in the annexed territories, which raise the national figure
